name: Encrypted Scroll
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the rogue trainer David Trias. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
narrative.objectives: Read the Encrypted Scroll and speak to David Trias in Deathknell.
narrative.offerRewardText: I spend most of my time here in the inn keeping an eye out for new faces and just keeping tabs on up-and-coming prospects. Keep your nose clean and I'll do what I can to teach you a few things. Just come back to me whenever you want, and we'll see if you're ready for a new skill or two.
narrative.requestItemsText: So you've made it? Good, we'll have need of more rogues as time goes on. The Shadowstalkers will probably wind up finding you when they think the time's right, so don't go and slip up or do anything you might regret. They need talented agents... not pickpockets and fools.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 1 to 2, 250 XP in all.
